mechanism: Perphenazine may increase photosensitivity risk, and adapalene as a retinoid causes inherent photosensitivity and skin irritation; combined use increases dermatologic adverse effects and phototoxicity potential.
action: Counsel patient on strict photoprotection (SPF 30+), avoid excessive sun exposure, and monitor for enhanced photosensitivity reactions and skin irritation; consider timing separation or alternative antipsychotic if severe dermatologic effects occur.
